thesis: Regression rerun: iteration 3 proved the four determinism properties on runtime 0.2.0 / taxonomy 0.2 / compiler 0.1.0. The stack has since changed substantially (two-file runtime 0.7.0, compiler 0.5.0 with expanded op vocabulary + annotate disposition + ENC-08 formula policy, taxonomy 0.4, spec format 0.4, compiler-first SKILL.md with naming convention). Iteration 4 re-verifies the same four properties on the new stack AND tests whether the three iteration-3 honest limits were actually closed: (a) compiler vocabulary now covers the 17-trap authoring task, (b) artifact naming now deterministic, (c) ENC-06 repair now report-counted.
baseline_policy: Baselines are deliberately NOT rerun. Baseline arms never touch the skill/runtime/compiler (they write ETL unaided), so the stack changes cannot alter their behavior; iteration-3 baseline measurements (0/4 properties) remain the valid comparison. Only the skill side could regress, so only skill arms are re-measured.

experiments.name: regeneration-determinism
experiments.setup: Mechanical: compile each spec 3x with compile_spec.py v0.5.0, run each pipeline against its sample. TWO specs now: vendor_orders (in-vocabulary since v0.1.0; direct comparability with iteration 3) and orders_export (the 17-trap spec that was OUTSIDE compiler vocabulary in iteration 3 — the honest-limit case, now expressible).
assertions: 3/3 run artifacts byte-identical per spec (output.csv, errors.jsonl, summary.json; manifest identical modulo completed_at_utc)

experiments.name: spec-authoring-convergence
experiments.setup: 3 independent isolated Opus agents, unattended, 17-trap orders_export.csv with target sample (identical prompt to iterations 2/3), each with its own copy of the current skill.
assertions: Decision agreement 3/3 (date format, mojibake repair, duplicate, ragged, footer)
Output value identity 3/3 pairs; summary identity 3/3
NEW (closes it-3 limit a): pipeline generated by compile_spec 3/3 (was 1/3 on v0.1.0)
NEW (closes it-3 limit b): artifact names identical 3/3 (orders_export.etlspec.yaml / orders_export_pipeline.py per SKILL.md naming convention)
NEW (closes it-3 limit c): ENC-06 repair counted in warnings_by_type (was uncounted via expr)

experiments.name: variant-robustness
experiments.setup: Mechanical: the E1 vendor_orders artifact vs the same 4 planted-problem variants as iteration 3 (v1 ragged STR-02, v2 unparseable date TYP-03, v3 non-numeric amount TYP-01, v4 overlong zip TYP-11).
assertions: Each planted problem quarantined under the exact taxonomy code; accounting reconciles; exit 2; raw row preserved

experiments.name: edit-propagation
experiments.setup: Mechanical spec edits + recompile. A: order_date MDY->DMY (wrong for the data; expect 1-line diff + ERR-02 loud failure). B: duplicate_rows keep->drop_exact (provable no-op). NEW C: error_disposition quarantine->annotate (new capability since it-3) run against the v2 bad-date variant — expect policy-line diff only; bad row LOADS with order_date NULLed + changes.jsonl ledger + exit 2. NEW D: spec upgraded 0.2->0.4 with formula_injection: neutralize — expect version+policy diff only; formula-leading cell prefixed + ENC-08 counted on a v5 formula variant.
assertions: Every edit's pipeline diff confined to the lines expressing that decision (+ spec-hash header)
A fails loud via ERR-02; B byte-identical outputs; C ledger + load + exit 2; D neutralized cell + ENC-08 count, signed numerics untouched

experiments.name: new-detection-coverage
experiments.setup: Mechanical: profiler v-current over a probe file exercising the detections added since iteration 3: formula-leading values (ENC-08), naive datetimes (TYP-04), dotted datetime (TYP-03 via time-tail stripping), 'Totally Organic' non-footer, version-number column (no TYP-03).
assertions: ENC-08 ask fires (grouped), TYP-04 ask fires, dotted datetime fires TYP-03, no footer false-positive, no version-number false-positive

model: opus-4.8 for all agent runs (comparability with iterations 2/3); agents isolated in scratch workdirs with their own skill copy
